ontology.note: GeoSPARQL geometry, PROV activity and QUDT buffer units. Also asserts fw:unconnectedSiteCount and fw:unconnectedSites for sites that reach nothing, fw:offNetworkSiteCount and fw:offNetworkSites for sites routed across unmapped ground, and fw:offNetworkMetres on each catchment that was. Configuration SHACL is future work. The emits list is computed per module, and src/catchments.ts also implements voronoi, clip_polygons and summarize_polygons, so it is the module's vocabulary rather than this widget's alone. The definition moved from src/core.ts#TYPES, where the widget is declared, to src/catchments.ts, where it computes and emits.

changes.description: The Preview draws where each site reaches along the streets, each time a band in its matplotlib tab10 colour, see-through, as Map draws it, computed by the run's own worker so the page is never held. It had given minutes times speed, the same number whatever the streets.

THE PREVIEW DRAWS (2026-11-27). tests/snow-previews.browser.mjs, on the John Snow isochrone example: four bands and one site, keyed 1, 5, 10 and 15 minutes; a change of times redraws two bands, and blocks the page under 500 ms. Measured the same day: computed in place it held the page 3.4 s on opening and on each change; through the worker, the dialog opened in 63 ms and the drawing came in about 4 s. Chromium only.
